subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds words using sounds learnt; groups words into sound families

show.line: You know so many sounds now! Let's build big words and sort them. Ship, chip, drip. The ip family!

rounds.prompt: Which family? ip, ash or ump? Sort the words.
Listen. j, u, mp. What word is it?
Ship. Change sh to dr. What word do you make?
Which word does not belong in the ump family?
rounds.praise: Ship is in the ip family.

rounds.text: Six frogs jump and splash in the pond.
accept: six frogs jump and splash in the pond
six frogs jump and splash in the pond.
six frogs jump and splash in a pond

hints: Listen to the end of the word. That is the family.
Sound it out part by part. First the start, then the rest.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will sort splash.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Splash goes in the ump family!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Splash ends in ash. It goes with crash.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen to the end. Splash, crash. The ash family!

parent_line: Can build and read longer words and sort them into sound families.
